map.末次月经（LMP）推算：记得末次月经第一天，可直接用 Naegele 法则：预产: Last menstrual period (LMP) method: if you remember the first day of your last period, use Naegele's rule directly: due date = LMP + 280 days (40 weeks). This is the most common method.
map.排卵日 / 早孕 B 超推算：若通过排卵试纸或 B 超确定排卵日，预产期 = 排: Ovulation / early ultrasound method: if the ovulation day is confirmed by test strips or ultrasound, due date = ovulation day + 266 days; a first-trimester ultrasound (before 12 weeks) back-calculates the LMP from the gestational age and then adds 280 days, giving a smaller error.
map.试管婴儿（IVF）推算：按胚胎移植日计算：第 5 天囊胚（D5）预产期 = 移植: IVF method: calculated from the embryo transfer date: a day-5 blastocyst (D5) gives due date = transfer date + (266 − 5) = transfer date + 261 days; a day-3 embryo (D3) gives +263 days.
map.LMP = 2026-01-01，预产期 = 2026-01-01 + 280: LMP = 2026-01-01, due date = 2026-01-01 + 280 days = 2026-10-08 (2026 is a common year; the 280th day from 1/1 is 10/8). The current gestational age is calculated in real time as (today − LMP)/7,

map.预产期为什么会差 1-2 周？: Why can the due date be off by 1-2 weeks?
map.Naegele 法则假设月经周期为 28 天且排卵在第 14 天，实际排卵日波动: Naegele's rule assumes a 28-day cycle with ovulation on day 14; real ovulation-day variation makes the due date vary by ±1 week. Ultrasound (especially early) can narrow the error to ±3-5 days. The due date is an "estimated range", not an exact date.
map.月经周期不规律怎么算？: How do I calculate with an irregular cycle?
map.周期偏长/偏短或月经不规律时，单靠 LMP 误差较大，建议以早孕 B 超（CRL: When the cycle is longer or shorter or irregular, LMP alone has a large error; it is better to recalculate using an early ultrasound (CRL crown-rump length) or a confirmed ovulation day (ultrasound/test strips).
